A Techmeme excerpt of Axios reporting says President Trump threatened to block overseas data-center construction by US companies or tax it heavily. The primary report was inaccessible.

A reported statement of intent is not an enacted prohibition or defined tax. Legal authority, affected projects, exceptions, rate and implementation date could not be checked, so the excerpt should not be used as operational compliance guidance.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed report excerpt
Tax amount and scope remain unspecified
